output.statute_applied: Article 54, Limitation Act, 1963 — 3 years (Specific performance of a contract)
output.fatal_flaw: Counting 3 years under Article 54 from 29 February 2020, the last day to file is 28 February 2023. The filing on 1 March 2023 is 1 day late. Under Section 3 a suit filed after the prescribed period must be dismissed, even if limitation is not raised as a defence.
curative_strategies: Delay in filing a suit cannot be condoned. Section 5 applies only to appeals and applications, so the remedy lies in showing that the period has not in fact expired.
Section 18: a written acknowledgment of liability, signed by the defendant before 28 February 2023, starts a fresh period from the date it was signed.
Section 19: a payment on account of the debt or interest, made before the period expired, starts a fresh period from the date of payment.
Section 14: if a civil proceeding on the same matter was prosecuted in good faith in a court without jurisdiction, the time it was pending is excluded.
Section 17: where the right or the facts were concealed by fraud, or the suit is for relief from a mistake, time runs from when it was discovered.
Check whether the suit, as actually framed, falls under a different article with a longer period or a later starting point.

output.fatal_flaw: Counting 3 years under Article 55 from 10 January 2022, the last day to file is 10 January 2025. The filing on 1 March 2025 is 50 days after that, and is in time only if the 106 days spent in pre-institution mediation are excluded under Section 12A(5) of the Commercial Courts Act, 2015, which moves the last day to 26 April 2025.
curative_strategies: File on or before 26 April 2025, and plead the Section 12A(5) exclusion expressly in the plaint.
The exclusion applies only to a commercial dispute of specified value in which pre-institution mediation under Section 12A was actually undertaken. Confirm both before relying on it.
Keep the mediation application and the Mediation Authority's report: they are the proof of the dates excluded.
Without the exclusion the suit is 50 days late, and delay in filing a suit cannot be condoned — Section 5 applies to appeals and applications, not suits.
